O.outcome_detail: agreement between expert item-LO mappings and response-model suggestions

result.effect: 20 of 754 possible item-LO changes adopted; 2.7% change rate; 19% adoption rate

cells.quote: Because the Q-matrix specifies the model structure in CD assessments, its appropriateness directly determines model–data fit. Misspecifications in the Q-matrix can lead to poor model fit and may produce inaccurate LO diagnoses for students.
cells.note: The study used posttest responses from 24,394 college students in 807 courses across 79 institutions. Three coders reviewed DINA-suggested changes and adopted changes only when all three reached consensus; the low change rate was interpreted as support for the final Q-matrix.
